purpose: Replace the failed global-RMS origin heuristic with an established onset/beat tracker and a deterministic four-beat accent-phase rule. This audit is audio-only and freezes regardless of result. It does not generate or score a candidate.

audioAnalysis.downbeatAccentEnvelope: equal-weight robust-normalized sum of percussive onset strength and 30-220 Hz positive spectral-flux envelope
audioAnalysis.tempo: librosa.feature.tempo from percussive onset envelope, aggregate median, max_tempo 200; if estimate is below 70 BPM, repeatedly double until >=70; if above 200 BPM, repeatedly halve until <=200
audioAnalysis.beatTracking: librosa.beat.beat_track using the frozen audio-derived tempo as bpm and percussive onset envelope
audioAnalysis.stableRun: earliest run containing at least 12 consecutive tracked beats whose adjacent intervals each lie within 15 percent of the run median beat interval; if none exists use all tracked beats and mark fallback
audioAnalysis.downbeatPhase: for residue 0..3 over stable tracked beats, compute median accent at that residue plus 0.35 times the 25th-percentile accent; choose highest score; ties choose smallest residue
audioAnalysis.origin: earliest tracked beat in the stable run whose global beat index has the chosen residue

validationOutputs: beat count and first 16 beat times
four residue accent scores and confidence margin
first 16 mapped sixteenth positions relative to origin
forbidden: reading V154 post-score shift or timebase diagnostic
Modal, NVIDIA L4, CUDA, or GPU execution
interpretation: Freeze output regardless of success. Only after freeze may the audio-only result be compared diagnostically with already-frozen V154 evidence. Do not promote the estimator merely because it happens to agree with the reference-derived shift.
